extraction.Name: Minnie Pourier, nee Dubray
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee to her 160 acre allotment, when it was issued, September 29, 1919; for she did not want to pay taxes, but the Indian Agency told her that, if she did not take it, the land would be assessed for taxes, for which it would later be sold, so she accepted the patent to the allotment
extraction.Buyer: Bank of Interior, South Dakota, for $900.00; bank foreclosed in 1923
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: got behind in taxes, for which reason, in 1921, she mortgaged her place to the Bank of Interior, South Dakota, for $900.00; that she failed to make her payments on this mortgage, and, in 1923, the bank foreclosed on her place
extraction.Occupation/Income: her husband supports her and the six children by farming the land of the children, which constitutes their only income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; has very poor health; mother of six minor children who have good health; husband has poor health; did not sell her place for debts incurred prior to receiving her patent in fee; considers she received a poor price for her land; never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; document sworn December 29, 1928
